lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense array of high-luminance circular blobs is visible across the lateral surface. A specific constellation of five larger, high-intensity blobs forms a rough pentagonal arrangement in the central region of the flank, posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, particularly in the anterior region, intersecting with the rows of high-luminance blobs to create a faint grid-like structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and a parallel shadowed region immediately below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent horizontal linear mark of low color saturation is visible in the upper-mid section of the flank, positioned approximately midway between the branchial slits and the right frame edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Five vertical branchial slits are clearly defined on the anterior lateral surface, displaying a repetitive series of high-contrast vertical shadows.
